narrative.summary: The World Bank Group publishes AI guidance for governments in its own name, notably a 2025 handbook on devising national AI strategies. Most of its other AI output consists of research reports and flagship studies that are not adopted by member countries.

instruments.official_title: Devising a Strategic Approach to Artificial Intelligence: A Handbook for Policy Makers
instruments.english_title: Devising a Strategic Approach to Artificial Intelligence: A Handbook for Policy Makers
instruments.summary: Handbook for policy makers on developing national AI strategies. It argues that AI, including generative AI, can support development and poverty reduction in low- and middle-income countries, warns of a widening AI divide, and offers a structured, adaptable framework and tools to help governments build strategic and responsible national approaches to AI suited to their context. It describes itself as non-normative, offering guidance and emerging good practice.
instruments.current_status: Published by the World Bank Group on 17 June 2025. Its framework and tools are described as guidance offered without being normative or prescriptive.
